requires: Artificer level 5; must have built a working prosthetic for another person
unlock: On floor 12 of the Fogglass Spire a soldier made of fog is missing an arm, a leg and an eye; build each piece from the floor's scrap before the mist takes the rest of him.
secret: The job only triggers if you have never charged anyone for a repair to their body.
notice: [Hidden job change. The patient walks out on his own feet. You are now trusted with the living.]
blurb: An Artificer who stops building machines to stand beside people and starts building them into people: grafted limbs, glass eyes and clockwork hearts for allies.
features: Skill: Fitted Graft

During a long rest, fit one ally with an iron graft that grants one: +10 feet speed, darkvision 60 feet, or advantage on Strength checks. You can maintain grafts on a number of allies equal to your Intelligence modifier.
Skill: Field Refit
As a bonus action, swap a grafted ally's benefit to another option, or let them spend a Hit Die as a reaction when hit.
Ultimate: Clockwork Heart
Once per long rest, when a grafted ally drops to 0 hit points, their graft starts their heart: they stand at hit points equal to your Artificer level times 2 and act immediately.
evolves: At level 15, if you have fitted 30 different people, your grafts can be forged from realm-graded materials that add their Potency to the bearer's attacks.
cost: Each graft carries a piece of your own lifeforce; your maximum hit points drop by 2 for every graft currently worn.

unlock: On floor 43 of the Sunken Spire a rusted ship's anchor on a chain lies across the stair; drag it down ten floors and use it to pull a drowned leviathan up from the dark.
secret: The job only triggers if you have grappled at least 100 creatures larger than yourself before entering.
notice: [Hidden job change. The chain is yours. What you catch, you keep.]
blurb: A Barbarian who fights with an anchor on a chain, hurling it out, hooking foes and hauling them in, turning the battlefield into a fishing ground.
features: Skill: Cast the Anchor
While raging, make a weapon attack against a creature within 30 feet (1d12 + Strength bludgeoning); on a hit it is pulled up to 25 feet toward you and grappled.
Skill: Dead Weight
A creature you grapple has its speed reduced to 0 and cannot teleport; you can slam it into another creature, dealing your rage damage to both.
Ultimate: Haul from the Deep
Once per long rest, swing the chain in a 30-foot circle: every creature within it makes a Strength save or is pulled prone beside you and takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage.
evolves: At level 15, if you have hauled a Huge creature off its feet, the chain grows to 60 feet and can catch flying creatures out of the sky.
cost: The anchor never floats: you sink in water, and losing the anchor ends your rage instantly.

requires: Bard level 5; proficiency with a drum or percussion instrument
unlock: On floor 33 of the Shuffled Spire the floors reshuffle to an unseen beat; find the rhythm, play it back on a drum, and the tower stops rearranging until you miss a note.
secret: The job only triggers if you have kept a single beat going for one full hour of combat or travel without stopping.
notice: [Hidden job change. The tower keeps time with you now. Do not miss a beat.]
blurb: A Bard who drives battle with rhythm instead of song, building a combo of beats that speeds allies and staggers foes the longer the drum keeps going.
features: Skill: Keep the Beat
Each round you play your drum as a bonus action, gain one Beat (max 5). Allies within 30 feet add your Beat count to their initiative and to one damage roll per turn.
Skill: Off-Beat
Spend 2 Beats as a reaction to make an enemy lose its footing: it has disadvantage on its next attack or save.
Ultimate: Crooked March
Once per long rest, spend 5 Beats: for 1 minute every ally within 30 feet gains an extra action each turn (Dash, Disengage or a single attack only).
evolves: At level 15, if a full party has fought to your drum for 50 battles, the march can be heard by allies anywhere in the same Tower or city.
cost: If you skip a round of drumming, all Beats are lost and allies take 1d6 psychic damage from the broken rhythm.

requires: Cleric level 5; must have driven out a possessing spirit
unlock: On floor 22 of the Ledger Spire a demon owns the soul of every person in a chained room; ring an iron bell over each and argue their names back out of the ledger without striking the demon once.
secret: The job only triggers if you have never accepted payment for a blessing, burial or exorcism.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bell tolls for what does not belong. Possession is no longer nine-tenths of the law.]
blurb: A Cleric who hunts the things that live inside others: possessing spirits, curses, parasites and borrowed souls, rung out with an iron bell.
features: Skill: Toll of Leaving
As an action, ring your bell: a creature within 30 feet makes a Charisma save or any possessing spirit, charm or curse on it is suppressed for 1 minute, and the source takes 3d8 radiant damage.
Skill: Name in the Ledger
Learn the true name of any fiend or undead you damage with Toll of Leaving; you have advantage on saves against it and it cannot become invisible to you.
Ultimate: The Last Bell
Once per long rest, ring a toll heard for 300 feet: every possessing or bound spirit is forced out of its host and must save or be banished to its home realm.
evolves: At level 15, if you have exorcised 30 spirits, your bell can be recast from a Hell-grade metal and toll against gods' contracts themselves.
cost: Everything you cast out remembers your face, and spirits seek you out to settle the score.

requires: Druid level 5; must have ended a drought or flood
unlock: On floor 23 of the Choir Spire the sky has cracked and the choir sings for rain that never comes; climb to the crack and dance the old rain-dance there until the clouds answer.
secret: The job only triggers if you have planted a seed in every realm you have visited.
notice: [Hidden job change. The sky has heard you. It will not forget your name.]
blurb: A Druid who leaves the forest behind and speaks to the weather, calling rain, hail, wind and lightning over the whole battlefield like the rainmakers of old village tales.
features: Skill: Call the Clouds
As an action, set the weather in a 120-foot radius for 10 minutes: Rain (fire damage halved, ranged attacks at disadvantage), Wind (flying speed halved) or Fog (heavily obscured).
Skill: Sky-Strike
While your weather is active, once per turn when you cast a spell, a bolt hits one creature in the area for 2d8 lightning or cold damage.
Ultimate: Cracked Sky
Once per long rest, split the clouds: for 1 minute, choose up to three points each round where hail and lightning fall, dealing 4d10 damage in a 10-foot radius (Dexterity save for half).
evolves: At level 15, if you have changed the weather in 10 different regions, your storms can last for days and shift Realm Pressure in the area by 1.
cost: Weather follows you: wherever you sleep, it rains, and crops fail if you stay a season.

requires: Fighter level 5; must have won 10 public duels or arena bouts
unlock: On floor 32 of the Shuffled Spire an endless arena shuffles its crowd and its rules each round; win five rounds in a row while making the crowd roar louder each time.
secret: The job only triggers if you have never killed a yielding opponent in a public fight.
notice: [Hidden job change. The crowd chants your name. You are the show now.]
blurb: A Fighter who fights for an audience, feeding on applause: flourishes, taunts and showmanship turn into real power on the sand.
features: Skill: Play to the Crowd
When you hit a creature, you can spend your bonus action on a flourish to gain one Cheer (max your proficiency bonus). Spend a Cheer to add 1d8 to an attack, save or damage roll.
Skill: Call the Challenger
As a bonus action, challenge one creature: it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you, and you gain a Cheer each time it misses you.
Ultimate: Thumbs Up, Thumbs Down
Once per long rest, when you reduce a creature to 0, you decide: it is spared and must answer one question truthfully, or you regain all Cheers and hit points equal to your Fighter level times 2.
evolves: At level 15, if a crowd of 1,000 has chanted your name, you can draw a phantom crowd into any battlefield.
cost: You cannot refuse a public challenge without losing all Cheers for a week.

requires: Monk level 5; must have disarmed 50 armed opponents
unlock: On floor 21 of the Ledger Spire a debt-collector armed with a thousand weapons demands your hands as payment; break every weapon he draws with bare hands until he has nothing left to collect with.
secret: The job only triggers if you have never owned a weapon worth more than a meal.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your hands are the debt that steel cannot collect.]
blurb: A Monk who answers steel with bare skin, catching, snapping and shattering weapons and armour until the enemy has nothing between them and the fist.
features: Skill: Catch the Blade
As a reaction when hit by a melee weapon, reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Monk level; if reduced to 0, spend 1 ki to snap a non-magical weapon or rip it away.
Skill: Crack the Shell
Your unarmed strikes reduce a creature's AC by 1 per hit until it repairs its armour (minimum 0), and deal double damage to objects and constructs.
Ultimate: Empty-Handed
Once per long rest, strike a creature's gear: every weapon, shield and armour it carries makes a Constitution save with your ki DC or shatters, magical items included.
evolves: At level 15, if you have broken a weapon of Hell grade or higher, your hands count as a weapon of that grade.
cost: You can never again wield a weapon or wear armour; touching one to fight breaks your vow and the job.

unlock: On floor 9 of the Milestone Spire a white horse with a broken bridle runs through every floor; earn its trust by walking beside it without a saddle for nine floors, then mend the bridle with your oath.
secret: The job only triggers if a mount of yours once died protecting you and you buried it.
notice: [Hidden job change. The bridle is mended. You will never ride alone.]
blurb: A Paladin who rides a holy steed that is half horse, half oath, charging through lines like the pale knights of old ballads.
features: Skill: Oath-Steed
Summon a spirit warhorse bound to your oath, with hit points equal to five times your Paladin level. While mounted, your Divine Smite can trigger on the steed's hoof attacks.
Skill: Breaking Charge
If you move 20 feet in a straight line while mounted, every creature you pass through makes a Strength save or is knocked prone and takes 2d8 radiant damage.
Ultimate: Ride Through
Once per long rest, the steed takes wing for 1 minute: flying speed 90 feet, and your aura extends to 60 feet while mounted.
evolves: At level 15, if you and your steed have ridden through all 10 floors of the Milestone Spire in a single day, it can carry your whole party across realms.
cost: If the steed falls, it cannot be summoned for 7 days and you lose your aura until it returns.

requires: Ranger level 5; must have raised a dog from a pup
unlock: On floor 7 of the Milestone Spire a pack of black dogs with ember eyes guards a churchyard; feed them from your own rations for seven days without raising a weapon, and the pack follows you out.
secret: The job only triggers if you have never left a wounded animal behind on the road.
notice: [Hidden job change. The pack has chosen you. They will guard your grave as they guarded theirs.]
blurb: Drawing on the old tales of black churchyard dogs that guard the dead, this Ranger leads a pack of spectral hounds instead of a single companion.
features: Skill: Whistle the Pack
Summon three black hounds (hit points equal to your Ranger level each, bite 1d8 + Wisdom modifier piercing). They act on your turn; you command all three with a bonus action.
Skill: Grave-Scent
Your hounds can track any creature that has bled within the last week, and see invisible and ethereal creatures within 60 feet.
Ultimate: The Black Pack Runs
Once per long rest, the pack swells to nine hounds for 1 minute, and each creature they bite must make a Wisdom save or be frightened of you.
evolves: At level 15, if your pack has guarded 20 graves or holy sites, one hound grows into a horse-sized alpha you can ride.
cost: The dogs howl when death is near, so you cannot sneak while they are summoned.

requires: Rogue level 5; Sleight of Hand expertise
unlock: On floor 23 of the Choir Spire a vault holds a gift from every god who ever sang there; steal one thing from it while the choir sings, and return the rest before the song ends.
secret: The job only triggers if you have stolen from someone richer than a lord and given every coin away.
notice: [Hidden job change. Even heaven loses things. You know where they went.]
blurb: A Rogue who steals more than coin: buffs, blessings, readied spells and the weapon right out of an enemy's hand, all lifted mid-fight like a magpie lifts a ring.
features: Skill: Light Fingers
When you hit with Sneak Attack, instead of extra damage you can steal one item the target holds or wears that is not armour, or end one beneficial spell on it.
Skill: Pocketed Blessing
A beneficial spell you end with Light Fingers is transferred to you for its remaining duration, without concentration.
Ultimate: Cleaned Out
Once per long rest, move up to your speed and touch every creature in your path: each loses one held item and one active benefit, all of which you may keep or hand to allies.
evolves: At level 15, if you have stolen something from a god's Finger, you can lift a contract's power for 1 minute.
cost: Everything you keep longer than a day draws a pursuer, and stolen holy gifts mark you to the gods' choirs.

unlock: On floor 11 of the Fogglass Spire a blacksmith of mist has no fire for his forge; pour your raw magic into his anvil until it glows, then forge a blade from nothing but power.
secret: The job only triggers if you have taken damage from your own spell at least 10 times.
notice: [Hidden job change. Your power has taken shape. Hold it carefully; it is still hot.]
blurb: A Sorcerer who stops throwing magic and starts holding it, forging raw power into blades, shields and chains of solid spell-stuff.
features: Skill: Forged Power
As a bonus action, spend 2 sorcery points to forge a weapon of raw magic that uses Charisma, deals 1d10 force, and adds your Charisma modifier to damage. It lasts 1 hour.
Skill: Quench
When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, pour it into your forged weapon instead: your next hit within 1 minute adds the spell's damage dice.
Ultimate: Molten Armoury
Once per long rest, forge a full armoury for 1 minute: +2 AC, your forged weapon strikes twice per attack action, and allies within 10 feet may wield copies.
evolves: At level 15, if you have forged a weapon in every element, your forged arms can take the grade and Potency of a material you hold.
cost: Your palms are permanently scarred; you cannot feel heat or cold and take 1 damage per hour a forged weapon is held.

requires: Warlock level 5; a contract with a god of Minor rank or higher, or a celestial patron
unlock: On floor 21 of the Choir Spire one voice in the choir sings off-key and is about to be cast out; take its verse into your own throat and sing it back into harmony before the judgement floor.
secret: The job only triggers if you have broken or renegotiated a pact without your patron punishing you.
notice: [Hidden job change. A fallen voice sings through you. Heaven is listening, for now.]
blurb: A Warlock whose patron is not a lord but a disgraced angel's voice, carried in the throat and spoken as commands the world must hear.
features: Skill: Borrowed Verse
Your eldritch blast or pact attacks can deal radiant damage; once per turn, a creature you hit must make a Wisdom save or obey a one-word command on its next turn.
Skill: Harmony

Allies within 30 feet who hear you speak a verse gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier plus your Warlock level at the start of each of your turns, for 1 minute (once per short rest).
Ultimate: The Fallen Voice Returns
Once per long rest, let the angel's voice sing fully for 1 minute: creatures of your choice within 60 feet are stunned for 1 round, then fiends and undead among them take 6d10 radiant damage.
evolves: At level 15, if you have sung the verse on every floor of the Choir Spire, the fallen voice can be returned to heaven, and you gain a Heaven contract of its rank.
cost: You cannot lie aloud; the voice sings over any falsehood you try to speak.

requires: Wizard level 5; must own a spellbook with at least 20 spells
unlock: On floor 44 of the Sunken Spire a library sinks one shelf per minute; copy the margin notes from every drowned book before the water rises over your head.
secret: The job only triggers if you have copied a spell from a scroll or book that was about to be destroyed.
notice: [Hidden job change. The margins remember. So will you.]
blurb: A Wizard who becomes a living archive, copying any spell that is cast near them into the margins of their book and reading it back.
features: Skill: Marginalia
When a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction to note it in your margins; you can cast that spell once before your next long rest using your own slots.
Skill: Footnote
Spells cast from your margins gain one free tweak: +1 to save DC, double range, or one extra target if the spell has a single target.
Ultimate: The Whole Library
Once per long rest, read every note in your margins at once: cast any two spells from them as a single action without spending slots.
evolves: At level 15, if your margins hold spells from 30 different casters, you can copy monster abilities and Skills as well as spells.
cost: Your margins only hold what you have seen; if your spellbook gets wet or burns, every noted spell is lost.
